plugins.name: pc-monitor
plugins.description: A one-line monitor above the Claude Code prompt: CPU, GPU, VRAM and RAM with live graphs, disks, active sessions and tokens per hour. Needs the monitor.py server from this repository.

plugins.name: side-panel
plugins.description: A side pane opened with /panel: every project's STATUS.md as a card (what waits for you, what is broken, the next step), your plan and ideas, plus a PC-now tab. Needs the monitor.py server from this repository.
